name: EVR-REAL-001 Taskboard CLI autonomous build
objective: Build a reliable local-first taskboard CLI from the provided incomplete starter while preserving the acceptance policy.
current_task: Implement taskboard.py so users can add, list, and complete tasks with durable JSON persistence and correct error handling.
decisions: Use the TASKBOARD_FILE environment variable when present and .taskboard.json otherwise.
Task IDs are positive sequential integers that continue across process restarts.
The existing acceptance tests are authoritative and must not be weakened.
constraints: Do not use network access or external dependencies.
Do not use SQLite or another database.
Invalid input must never corrupt existing JSON task data.
failed_attempts: A previous stub left persistence methods as NotImplementedError; do not paper over failures by changing tests.
blockers: The starter implementation is intentionally incomplete and all acceptance tests fail until the CLI is implemented.
next_action: Inspect taskboard.py, POLICY.md, and test_taskboard.py; implement the CLI completely; run python -m unittest -v before finishing.
